sloka: न चान्यो राक्षसान्हन्ता सुरारीन्देवकण्टकान् ।ऋते नारायणं देवं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् ।। ७.८.२५ ॥
transliteration: na cānyo rākṣasānhantā surārīndevakaṇṭakān ।ṛte nārāyaṇaṁ devaṁ śaṅkhacakragadādharam ।। 7.8.25 ॥

translations.english: O highly fortunate one, all of them were more powerful than Rāvaṇa.
